name: Magic UI
notes: MIT-licensed (LICENSE file + GitHub metadata), actively maintained (~22k stars, last push 2026-08-11). Not an npm runtime package: components are copied into your project via the shadcn CLI registry (npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/<slug>), the same distribution model as shadcn/ui. Built for React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Motion (Framer Motion successor) with shadcn/ui conventions (cn utility, components/ui directory); some components pull extra peer deps automatically via registryDependencies (e.g. cobe for Globe, canvas-confetti for Confetti, react-tweet for Tweet Card). Their paid products are templates (pro.magicui.design), not components - all 76 components are free. Categories are the library's own docs-sidebar groupings (Components, Special Effects, Animations, Text Animations, Device Mocks, Buttons, Backgrounds, Community). List verified complete against apps/www/content/docs/components/ on repo main branch as of 2026-08-29: 76 mdx files match 76 sidebar entries with no orphans. Note: slug 'highlighter' is titled 'Text Highlighter' and slug 'animated-theme-toggler' is titled 'Theme Toggler'.
